title: 苹果印度年销：首破百亿美元，下一站能到多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What's within this $10 billion right? For a long time we've been tracking Apple's traction in that market.
segments.zh: 这100亿美元里有什么？长期以来我们一直在追踪苹果在该市场的表现。

segments.en: It's a very different economy to others that Apple prioritizes. Give us all the info we need.
segments.zh: 与其他苹果优先市场相比，这是一个非常不同的经济体。给我们所有需要的信息。

segments.en: So in these numbers, which I should say we're previously unreported before Bloomberg reported them, it was the iPhone, iPhone products that were leading those sales. It turned out that MacBooks and
segments.zh: 在这些数据中，之前未公开，直到彭博报道，iPhone产品引领了销售。结果是MacBook和iPad也上涨，但真正引领销售激增的是iPhone，从上一财年的90亿美元上升。

segments.en: iPads were up to, but really the iPhone, which is of course what the company is most known for, was leading that sales surge up from nine billion in the prior fiscal year.
segments.zh: 彭博还有另一份关于苹果的重要报道，即CEO约翰·特努斯，即将于9月1日上任的CEO，引进了一些人才，为管理团队带来领导力，但那是已经离开、已经退休的人。我们说的是谁？

segments.en: There's another big report from Bloomberg on Apple and that is that CEO John Ternus, well, CEO as of September 1st incoming CEO, has brought in some talent, a lead effort for
segments.zh: 是的，劳拉·利格罗斯，她之前是他负责硬件工程时的副手，是副总裁级别。苹果召回退休高管并不常见，但这可能对约翰·特努斯有利，因为他进入新角色时，可以依靠这位在他之前职位上忠诚可靠的人。我们不太清楚她会做什么。

segments.en: the management team, but it's somebody that had left, that had retired. Who are we talking about?
segments.zh: 她将担任副总裁，我们得知她将从事跨职能、跨学科的工作，但这将超越她之前硬件工程的领域。我认为世界各地的大多数人

segments.en: Yes, so Laura Ligros, who was his lieutenant previously when he ran hardware engineering, she was a vice president at that level. And it isn't usual for Apple to bring back retired
segments.zh: 是的，劳拉·利格罗斯，她之前是他的副手，负责硬件工程，当时是副总裁级别。苹果让退休高管回归并不常见。

segments.en: executives, but it will probably serve John Ternus well as he settles into this new role to reach toward someone who was so loyal and reliable in his previous post. And we don't know too much
segments.zh: 高管们，但这可能对约翰·特努斯有好处，因为他适应新角色时，会想到前任的忠诚和可靠。我们不太清楚

segments.en: about what she will be doing. She will here to be a vice president, and we know that she'll be working in what is essentially across functional, cross-disciplinary function, but it will go beyond
segments.zh: 关于她的职责，她将担任副总裁，负责跨职能、跨领域的工作，但职责范围会更广。

segments.en: just beyond her previous realm of hardware engineering. And I think most people around the world
segments.zh: 这已超出她此前负责的硬件工程领域。我认为全球大多数人
